questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.
The cashier had finished the assigned task on time.
options: 1) The assigned task had been finished by the cashier on time.
2) The assigned task is finished by the cashier on time.
3) The assigned task was finished by the cashier on time.
4) The assigned task has been finished by the cashier on time.
questions.solution: A) The assigned task had been finished by the cashier on time.
